observations: Candidate Piercing Dawn has visibly broader separated gold solar strokes around the upper body and the distant projectile compared with the thin baseline strokes.

The open centre preserves the aim corridor and the five target labels in this fixed 1280x960 daylight view. One right-hand stroke crosses part of the turquoise middle target, so this frame does not establish zero target occlusion.
The effect remains visibly ribbon-like. Layering, temporal rhythm, hit satisfaction, multiple simultaneous casters and night contrast cannot be judged from this single frozen release.
acceptance: Visible presentation change confirmed for one matched actual release still. No full-ability, continuous-motion, competitive-readability or AAA acceptance.
next_review: View all twenty actual windup/release/contact/end raw frames after corrected-source capture; ordinary mode only. Reduced modes currently have CPU lifecycle/geometry assertions, not pixel review.
